nom: The Ordinary Volufiline 92% + Pal-Isoleucine 1% Plumping Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin describe the serum as noticeably greasy and one reports it can't be worn in the morning under makeup, though it still absorbed for another user.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin (age 36) reports zero visible results after finishing the bottle over two months.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer states she does not have sensitive skin but still felt a strange tingling sensation when using the product on her lips.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers using the serum for nasolabial folds, marionette lines, forehead lines and under-eye hollows report visible plumping and softened lines with consistent use over weeks to months; a minority (ages not specified) saw zero change after three weeks to two months of use.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the product leaves skin feeling more hydrated and plump the morning after use, describing it as compatible with dry winter conditions.
concerns.redness: One reviewer specifically notes no redness despite tingling, and another reports no burning or irritation at all.
concerns.barrier: No reviews specifically describe barrier repair or damage.
concerns.spots: No reviews specifically describe an effect on dark spots or hyperpigmentation.
concerns.blemishes: Two reviewers report new breakouts on the cheeks where the product was applied for nasolabial folds; most other reviewers, including several using it on the same areas, report no breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers describe the formula itself as oily or greasy on application, with one oily-skinned user restricting use to nighttime only; most say it absorbs quickly despite the initial oily feel.

extraits.titre: Review after finishing the whole bottle
extraits.texte: It took me about 2 months of (somewhat) consistent use to get through the bottle. Im sad that ive seen zero results. Ive been using it across some lines on my forehead. In the hollows under my eyes and around my lips for more fullness. I have seen zero results. It tingles a lot when i put it around my lips (no redness or anything) so i thought that was a good sign. But after comparing photos of when i first started using on my face to now, i dont see any difference. Im disappointed because reddit users swear by volufiline. They were mostly speaking of a french brand that first introduced this formula, so maybe its just this brand. Ive always had great results with this brand, so i was hopeful. Seems to work for others though! I have combo skin and im 36 years old.
This broke me out in the areas I focused on (cheeks for nasolabial folds). Unfortunately, for that reason, I am returning.

Im 35 years old and have noticed fat loss underneath my eyes. The area seems more hollowed out. I saw someone on tiktok state this product makes their orbital area look 60-70% and oddly enough that's the best way to describe how it improved the area. My orbital looks significantly and notably more full. Because the product is clumsy to disperse, I've been using the back of my hand. That area looks like it grew a small circular bump. It filled the small lines on my forehead and reduced the huge wrinkle between my eye brows (but obviously didnt make it disappear). The only con is that its super oily. It broke me out if I used it anywhere below that orbital are .

I'm 38 & have noticed loss of volume under my eyes. I've been using this nightly for 5 days under my eyes & I can already see significant plumpness & smoothing of fine lines. I'm shocked at my personal results & would highly recommend! To dispense, I put my ring finger over the stopper & give it a good shake. I do that several times until I'm satisfied with the amount I've put on, as it does dispense too much if i drop it out on the back of my hand. I'm using it on the deeper lines between my eyes & forehead & haven't noticed much difference there thus far, but I'm floored with the under eye difference The *only* con I've experienced is I have pretty oily skin & since the serume is oil based, I definitely can't use it in the am so I'm missing out on 2x daily application. Can't speak to how it behaves on dryer skin for morning use under makeup

extraits.titre: Good product, bad bottle. Ordinary- please improve!!
extraits.texte: Desperately wish this product 1) was perhaps a touch larger for the price, and most importantly 2) had a dropper, roller, or other system for application. The bizarre plastic insert (much like an essential oil dropper bit) either rushes too much product out at once, or none at all. I'm tempted to try and funnel it into a click-up brush applicator, but at the price per ounce I worry about wasted product on the funnel or any accidental spills. It does feel oily/nonpolar to the touch as others have mentioned, but isn't unpleasant to me at all and is very compatible with massage and lymphatic drainage techniques like gua sha. It can sometimes tingle around the eyes especially, so don't be alarmed if this occurs- but definitely don't apply too heavily, because it will burn if it seeps across skin INTO the eyes. Product creates a noticeable difference pretty speedily for sunken areas of the face as well as lines and wrinkles (be it from aging or dynamic wrinkling from dehydration, stress, etc.). It absorbs well and I have had no issue with pilling when used with squalane and oil based moisturizers.

I don't have sensitive skin, because at first it does give you a strange sensation, but it's not painful. I've been using it on my lips and they definitely feel more plump and hydrated. The product absorbs well, but it is a little oily, although that feeling doesn't bother me on my lips. complimentary from The Ordinary , gifted by The Ordinary

extraits.titre: works but not a quick fix
extraits.texte: after two months of usage twice a day, I started to see a difference in my undereye hallows and smile lines. its sublte but my undereyes look less sunken in and my smile lines have softened to a point of almost being unnoticeable. if you're patient and diligent, you'll see results. at 40, this is what I was hoping for. its not going to do what filler can achieve but i also dont want to go that route. I will be repurchasing.
